audit: H2 direct all-page visual inspection: ASMBI supplement
scope: Read-only actual PDF and PNG review. Only this JSON and its Markdown companion were written; no source/results/PDF edits, rerender, commit, or delegated subagent.
style_basis: Task context states ASMBI uses permitted Free Format with official AMA because the original NJD offline template dependency was unavailable. This audit checks the actual rendered PDF and does not claim unchanged NJD template fidelity or independently reverify journal policy.
limitations: This is a direct visual-layout and visible scientific-boundary preservation check, not a new numerical reproduction or literature verification.
No claim of original NJD-template rendering is made.
All 50 individual PNGs were viewed; no page was certified solely from extracted text or an unviewed image.

focus_checks.na_failures: PASS: visible NA/FAILED/FAIL/NOT_MET and absent-test distinctions retained, including p12–17, p22–27 and dense MCS tables.

focus_checks.g2: PASS: p45 Table S50 retains Four-feature H6 median-screen Fail; p46 disaggregated plot remains visible.
focus_checks.g3: PASS: p47 retains 8/60 tail failures, +80.98% worst excess, fallback/regression allocation 32/28, and retrospective limitation.
focus_checks.imported_wp2_s39: PASS: p47 S39 states partial support (semantic PARTLY), p48 keeps full-regression P2 Not testable plus all 25 counterexample rows and failed screens.
focus_checks.references: PASS_WITH_NOTE: self-contained list [1]–[33] at p49–50; entry [33] has an editorial metadata/punctuation anomaly.

issues.location: References [33], final entry near bottom of page
issues.observation: The visible entry contains “Historical compressed. ; . Retrieved October 24, 2026.” with empty-field punctuation and no displayed URL.
issues.impact: The bibliography exists as a self-contained 33-entry list and the line is readable, but the final web-source entry is editorially incomplete or awkward and is less directly locatable from the PDF alone.
issues.requested_action: Parent task should check the source metadata and render the corrected reference if it decides this note must be resolved. No source or PDF was changed by this visual audit.
